name: AXM Launcher Card Proposal
summary: Preview and export governed launcher distribution metadata through Publish & Library without modifying manifests.
notes: User-initiated proposal builder for manifest.card metadata. v0.2 exports review data only because the Workshop server intentionally has no /api/tool-card write route.

User must review and apply the exported proposal in a separate governed step.
